english.title: Drive HCV on M20 without permission / direction
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 3(2) and (4) of the Heavy Commercial Vehicles in Kent (No.3) Order 2019, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drove a heavy commercial vehicle
on any part of the coastbound carriageway between junction 8 and 9 of the M20 motorway
when a relevant provision has permitted other coastbound traffic to proceed on the carriageway
otherwise than in compliance with regulation 3(2) of the Heavy Commercial Vehicles in Kent (No.3) Order 2019

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from 31st October 2021 as per SI 2021/973 and SI 2021/1206. For the offence applying before this date, see H22413.
(ii) For fixed penalty see table 7 of Schedule 2 to the Fixed Penalty Order 2000.
